messages:
maya.cs: Heads up — onboarding indexer stalled for a subset of new accounts (ingest reconciliation errors). Affects ~42 active trial/onboarders. I\u2019m drafting an external status update; need mitigation plan + comp recommendations. @liam.eng can you confirm ETA on a manual catch-up/backfill job?

liam.eng: Investigating now. devops-bot flagged indexer-worker-3 OOM after retry storm. We recycled the process but backlog still present. Kicking off a manual backfill (shard-by-shard). ETA ~3h optimistic; will post progress updates.

devops-bot: Alert: indexer-worker-3 OOM -> restarted at 2024-11-22T09:12Z. Current backlog: ~12k docs. Dashboard: https://dash/restarts/idx-3

nina-se: We need customer-facing copy + a prioritized list for renewals. Suggest short status + recovery window + invite to office hours + comp-offer. Do we have a draft to send to top accounts?

maya.cs: Draft below — please review. I\u2019m proposing 1 month credit for impacted trials and a complimentary 2x SE enablement session for higher-touch accounts.

maya.cs: ```
Subject: Temporary indexing delay — update and next steps

Hi {FirstName},
We\u2019re reaching out to let you know we\u2019re addressing a temporary issue impacting new document indexing for a small number of onboarding accounts. Our engineering team is running a manual catch-up and we expect most accounts to be reconciled within 2-4 hours.

What we\u2019re doing: manual backfill + monitoring, targeted office hours for immediate assistance.
What we\u2019re offering: 1 month of service credit for affected trials; priority SE time for customers on paid plans.
We\u2019ll send hourly updates and a short post-incident summary. Reply if you need an immediate manual import.
Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

omar.pm: I agree with the approach. Let\u2019s avoid committing >1 month credit for enterprise until eng confirms full recovery, but approve 1 month for trials. Flagged renewal-risk accounts: AcmeCorp, Parkside.ai, StandardSYS (high MRR) ". Recommend targeted outreach after we confirm status.

jess-support: Starting targeted messages to top 10 affected accounts now. I\u2019ll include the \"how to request manual import\" link and schedule 2pm office hours. Will paste any replies into this thread.

liam.eng: Manual backfill job started: progress 0% -> 35% (10m). Throttling tuned to avoid OOM. If OOM repeats we will fallback to shard-by-shard catch-up which may extend ETA. Will update in 30m.

maya.cs: Thanks. Plan: hourly customer-facing status updates until clear; collect replies and immediate requests. @jess-support please handle the first wave in the next 30m.

jess-support: On it. Sending to top 10 now (subject: Action required: temporary indexing delay  status update).

nina-se: :thumbsup: please collect any customer asks here. We should capture if they request immediate manual import or express renewal concerns.

devops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-4587. Severity: P2. Link: https://inc/INC-2024-4587

maya.cs: Action items recap:
1) Eng: post progress + ETA updates in-thread (liam.eng)
2) CS: send hourly comms + collect replies (jess-support, nina-se)
3) PM: approve comp offer for trials & advise on enterprise escalation (omar.pm)
4) Post-incident: RCA + customer-facing summary (maya.cs / omar.pm)

liam.eng: Update: 57% complete (30m). Catch-up pace improving after throttle adjustment.

maya.cs: Closing note for now: if any of the flagged renewals escalate, ping me + exec-sales immediately. We\u2019ll prepare targeted outreach and tailored credit/enablement options.
